changelog:
- Initial release of the `oo-gupshup` skill for working with Gupshup through an OOMOL-connected account.
- Supports reading Gupshup data, including listing available message templates.
- Supports sending approved template messages through Gupshup.
- Supports sending text messages in active WhatsApp conversations through Gupshup.
- Uses the `oo` CLI connector flow, with live schema inspection before building action payloads.
- Includes clear safety guidance for write actions and first-time setup fallback only when authentication or connection fails.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@d6fb756`
summary: Gupshup (gupshup.io). Use this skill for ANY Gupshup request — reading, creating, and updating data. Whenever a task involves Gupshup, use this skill instead of calling the API directly.
